pyramiding_rule: Absolute ban on adding positions within 300 seconds of an active trade; zero pyramiding permitted while net floating profit is negative.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require live ATR (14) structural alignment on M15 frame and hard-cap maximum order risk at $5.00 inclusive of broker commission and spread.
profit_harvest_threshold: Lock dynamic breakeven + $1.00 at +$3.00 unrealized gain; execute 50% partial harvest at +$7.50 and trail remaining position at 1.5 ATR.
